alignments.adjudication: Reader English remembers dust; man days grass; not always strive/anger; not dealt according sins. These correspond to Brenton 102:14b,15a,9,10 and modern covering Ps 103:14-15,9-10, in that order. Not Reader printed 102:13,8-9, not modern Psalm 102, and no ways-to-Moses verse 7. Partial endpoint verses are covering loci, not whole-verse word identity.
Full Reader clauses forgiven iniquity/covered sin, taken away wrath/turned fierce anger match Brenton 84:2-3; modern Ps 85:2-3. The Reader printed 84:2 covers both verses; retain it separately.

Reader father pities children followed by east/west removal matches Brenton 102:13 then 102:12; modern Ps 103:13 then 103:12. Reader printed 102:12,11 differs. These are explicit complete-clause matches, not a blanket chapter/verse offset.
